fieldData.job-spec:
What is the job?

No matter how powerful and flexible you build a platform, at the end of the day it’s the presentation to the user that defines the experience! In order to help us do this, Radix is seeking a savvy Junior Digital Designer to come build the experiences that will define the future of decentralized finance (DeFi).

In this role, you will work closely with the Head of Design, working between Product and Marketing teams on a variety of design work on both print and digital platforms.

You will not just be an order taker; we need someone who can generate ideas to solve novel needs. You will also have an experimental approach, and are open to taking risks!

What are we looking for?

  • You will enjoy working in an ambitious, fast-paced environment that requires conceptual, strategic thinking and a willingness to collaborate to create highly visible work across multiple channels.
  • You have a keen eye for detail, strong visual design skills and a portfolio to demonstrate your inspiring creative work showcasing conceptual thinking.
  • You’ll be iterating rapidly on feedback from stakeholders across the business, so some experience in real-life constraints such as stakeholders that give you limitations and a time-based project is necessary.
  • You’ll help build out and shape our design strategy across social media and key marketing campaigns by crafting creative narratives across channels.
  • Integrate closely with the Product and Marketing team to ensure that the brand is fully represented across all communication channels.
  • You’ll have a willingness to take creative risks but also to follow and interpret creative direction.
  • You’ll have a thorough understanding of creative trends in tech, branding, advertising and related fields.
  • You are a problem solver and can do so with minimum direct supervision.
  • You see the big picture but understand that great brands, and great design, require a keen attention to detail.
  • You have excellent time management and you know how to manage multiple priorities, breaking large projects into manageable pieces.

What do you need?

  • A portfolio of inspiring creative work showcasing conceptual thinking and strong visual design skills (including illustration and motion skills)
  • Ability to create work in multiple styles across print and digital
  • Proficient in Adobe CC
  • Strong visual design skills
  • Good skills in Motion/Animation design (After Effects)
  • Experience designing for social channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube etc)
  • Good understanding of design principles, typography and colour theory

Nice to haves:

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally - working with product teams
  • 3D design skills
  • Have a basic understanding of the crypto and DeFi industry

Who are we?

At Radix, we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

Radix went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply here or email farrah@radixdlt.com for more information.
